title: Multi-Robot Manipulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim (2025–2026): Cooperative Assembly, Deformable Handling, and Self-Driving Labs
ledeHtml: Direct LLM-to-actuator dispatch breaks down in shared multi-arm workcells. Across cooperative assembly, deformable object handling, and Self-Driving Laboratories (SDLs), 2025–2026 robotics stacks have converged on a four-tier neuro-symbolic and GPU physics pipeline. Vision-language planners emit typed task graphs (TaskDAG or MM-TPG) rather than joint trajectories. Deterministic pre-flight gates verify kinematics, swept-volume collisions, and zone mutexes before hardware execution. GPU controllers run 50 to 120 Hz inverse kinematics and bimanual tension control, while fault logs write rejected constraints back into the planner prompt. This report synthesizes 14 systems, including APEX-MR, RoboFactory, RoCo, IndustReal, cuRobo, DexGarmentLab, MoDeSuite, SOI, MATTERIX, ORGANA, A-Lab GPSS, and AlabOS, and shows how Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) unifies them in NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 and ROS 2 Jazzy.
hubTitle: SOTA Survey (2025-2026): Multi-Robot Assembly, Deformable Manipulation & Self-Driving Labs in Isaac Sim
hubDesc: Comparative synthesis of 14 neuro-symbolic and GPU physics systems, including MATTERIX, APEX-MR, RoboFactory, DexGarmentLab, ORGANA, and Project STAMP.
bodyHtml:
TL;DR: The Four-Tier Neuro-Symbolic and GPU Physics Architecture
  • Tier 1, Task Graph Synthesis (Plan): Vision-language planners parse overhead and wrist camera streams plus 3D scene transforms into typed Directed Acyclic Task Graphs (TaskDAGs) or Multi-Modal Temporal Plan Graphs (MM-TPGs). Planners never output raw joint trajectories.
  • Tier 2, Pre-Flight Safety Gate and Contention Scheduler (Gate): A deterministic gate checks 7-DoF inverse kinematics, 3D AABB swept-volume collisions, URDF joint and torque bounds, and multi-arm zone or tool mutexes before MoveIt 2 or hardware dispatch.
  • Tier 3, 50 to 120 Hz Skill and Motion Control (Execute): GPU motion generators (cuRobo and Damped Least-Squares IK) track C2-continuous trajectories, enforce closed-chain leader-follower constraints, and hold outward rim tension on flexible containers.
  • Tier 4, Closed-Loop Context Repair (Write-Back): Rejected plans or runtime pose slips produce structured HardwareFaultLog certificates. The feedback module injects those constraints back into the planner context (write_limit_back) or splices a zero-token recovery subgraph.
Systems Surveyed
14 Frameworks
RSS, ICCV, NeurIPS, Nature Comput. Sci., Matter
Makespan Reduction
-21% to -48%
ORGANA (-21.1%) & APEX-MR MM-TPGs (-48%)
STAMP Gate Shield
100.0%
610 of 610 injected multi-arm faults blocked
Write-Back Completion
39% → 100%
1,000 episodes via HardwareFaultLog repair
TL;DR Video Synthesis: 40s Survey Overview across Assembly, Deformables, and Self-Driving Labs (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) Direct MP4 Stream (blog4-wrapup-omni.mp4) ↗
Tier 1 • Plan
Multimodal Task Graph Planner

Grounds overhead and wrist RGB-D streams plus 3D /tf frames into a typed TaskDAG or MM-TPG with explicit zone and tool locks.

Tier 2 • Gate
Deterministic Pre-Flight Gate & RCPSP

Checks 7-DoF IK solutions, 3D AABB swept-volume clearances, URDF torque limits, and time-window mutexes across shared stations.

Tier 3 • Execute (PASS)
50–120 Hz Multi-Arm Control & Physics Twin

Runs DLS IK or cuRobo MPC and closed-chain bimanual trajectories inside 240 Hz PhysX TGS, SDF, and PBD Isaac Sim scenes.

Tier 4 • Write-Back (REJECT)
Closed-Loop Fault Context Injection

Writes HardwareFaultLog certificates into planner context (write_limit_back) or splices zero-token recovery subgraphs.

1. Cooperative Multi-Robot Assembly: Asynchronous Plan Graphs and Sub-Millimeter Contact

Shared multi-arm workspaces hit two physical bottlenecks: spatial deadlocks between colliding links and closed-chain over-constraint when two arms grasp one rigid part. Systems from 2024 and 2025 separate symbolic task assignment from asynchronous graph scheduling and CUDA motion generation. Waiting arms pre-stage outside locked zones while active arms execute sub-millimeter contact insertions.

Domain 1 • Multi-Robot Collaboration & Contact-Rich Assembly (2024–2025) M9G-TR-2026-04 Survey
Framework & Venue Core Architectural Contribution Design Rule for Project STAMP
APEX-MR (CMU · RSS 2025)
arXiv:2503.15836 · GitHub		 Asynchronous Multi-Modal Temporal Plan Graphs (MM-TPGs): APEX-MR drops lockstep barrier waits so non-contending arms pre-position asynchronously, cutting multi-arm idle makespan by 48%. Pre-stage waiting arms (STAGED_PRE_GATE) outside the central zone while another arm holds the placement mutex.
RoboFactory & RoboFactory-VLA (ICCV 2025)
arXiv:2503.16408 · GitHub		 Compositional Multi-Agent Guards: RoboFactory encodes spatial, temporal, and bimanual synchronization rules as explicit verification guards between agent planning and trajectory execution. Block invalid dispatches before execution with typed fault codes (IK_UNREACHABLE, WORKSPACE_COLLISION, RESOURCE_CONTENTION, JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED).
RoCo (ICRA 2024)
arXiv:2307.04738 · GitHub		 Environment-Grounded LLM Refinement: RoCo feeds collision and inverse-kinematics validation errors back into multi-turn LLM dialogues to repair sub-task assignments and 3D waypoints. Replace multi-turn agent debate with one deterministic gate check and a single structured write_limit_back repair prompt.
NVIDIA Factory & IndustReal (RSS · Isaac Lab)
arXiv:2205.03532 · NVIDIA Blog		 SDF Contact & Task-Space Impedance in Isaac Sim: IndustReal combines Signed Distance Field (SDF) meshes with 240 Hz PhysX Temporal Gauss-Seidel (TGS) solvers to run sub-millimeter peg-in-hole and gear insertion in real time. Pair 240 Hz PhysX TGS contact and high-friction grasp pads with C2-continuous quintic trajectories to prevent internal part strain.
NVIDIA cuRobo & isaac_ros_cumotion
cuRobo Docs · GitHub		 CUDA Parallel IK & Collision-Free MPC: cuRobo solves collision-free inverse kinematics and model-predictive trajectories in under 5 ms on GPU for ROS 2 and MoveIt 2. Combine sub-5 ms per-arm CUDA motion generation with a wavefront contention scheduler across shared multi-arm cells.

2. Deformable Object Handling: Structural Keypoints and Outward Bimanual Tension

Compliant bags, garments, silicone baskets, and wire harnesses deform across thousands of mesh vertices. Feeding raw vertex clouds into a vision-language planner destabilizes grasp grounding. Recent Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab stacks instead track low-dimensional structural keypoints such as rims, collars, and dual handles, while holding outward tension during bimanual transport.

Bimanual Structure-of-Interest (SOI) Outward Tension Rule Ref: SOI Bag Manipulation · Project STAMP Modes 2 & 5
Dual-Gripper Handle Span = Nominal Rim Width + (2 × Outward Tension Offset). Holding this span keeps flexible container rims taut and prevents inward buckling during synchronized bimanual lifts.
Domain 2 • Deformable Object Manipulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim & Isaac Lab M9G-TR-2026-04 Survey
Framework & Venue Core Architectural Contribution Design Rule for Deformable TAMP
DexGarmentLab & GarmentLab (NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight · Isaac Sim)
arXiv:2505.11032 · GitHub · arXiv:2411.01200		 PhysX 5 PBD & FEM Bimanual Suite: DexGarmentLab benchmarks 15 bimanual deformable tasks in Isaac Sim and anchors grasp policies on category-level structural keypoints (left and right handles, rims, and collars). Bind VLM tool calls to canonical handle offsets (offset_1, offset_2) instead of raw deformable surface vertices.
MoDeSuite (Isaac Sim & Isaac Lab)
GitHub · NVIDIA DLO Guide		 Mobile & Stationary Elastic Manipulation: MoDeSuite evaluates mobile bases and manipulators handling elastic ropes, cables, cloths, and bags inside Isaac Lab. Pair base and arm reachability checks with compliant grasp settle windows (>= 400 ms) prior to upward lift.
Structure-of-Interest (SOI) Bag Manipulation (IEEE · arXiv)
arXiv:2401.11432		 Rim Keypoint Tracking & Tensioned Lift: SOI extracts the bag mouth rim and dual handles as low-dimensional Structures of Interest and applies an outward tension offset (gripper span = nominal rim width + 2 × tension offset) during packing and transport. Command an outward tension_offset along the handle axis during bimanual LIFT so packed items neither pinch nor spill.

3. Self-Driving Laboratories: In-Silico Protocol Verification and Mutex-Locked Stations

Autonomous wet-lab chemistry and solid-state synthesis tolerate zero reagent spills, broken glassware, or glovebox collisions. Self-Driving Laboratories (SDLs) in 2025–2026 validate protocols in GPU physics twins first and lock every shared instrument as a mutexed DAG resource before physical dispatch.

Domain 3 • Autonomous Self-Driving Laboratories (SDLs) & GPU Digital Twins (2025–2026) M9G-TR-2026-04 Survey
Framework & Venue Core Architectural Contribution Design Rule for Lab TAMP
MATTERIX (Acceleration Consortium & NVIDIA · Nature Comput. Sci. 2025/2026)
Nature Comput. Sci. · News & Views · arXiv:2601.13232 · GitHub		 Multiscale GPU Chemistry Digital Twin: MATTERIX validates wet-lab protocols in GPU physics before hardware execution. Built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, it couples LLM planners with arm kinematics, glassware contact, powder and liquid particle dynamics, heat transfer, and reaction kinetics. Run Isaac Sim pre-flight gates to catch glassware collisions, liquid spills, and station contention prior to physical lab execution.
ORGANA (Univ. of Toronto · Matter / Cell Press)
Matter Paper · Project Site		 Parallel Chemistry TaskDAG Scheduling: ORGANA compiles natural-language experiment goals into parallelizable TaskDAGs, cutting experiment makespan by 21.1% and technician workload by over 80% with overhead and wrist perception. Pair global overhead RGB-D (OverheadCamera) with eye-in-hand wrist cameras (wrist_camera) under wavefront DAG scheduling.
A-Lab GPSS (arXiv 2026) & AlabOS (Berkeley Lab)
arXiv:2604.11957 · arXiv:2405.13930 · Nature Rev. Chem. 2026		 Mutex-Locked Lab OS & Fault Recovery: AlabOS locks every furnace, vessel, and transfer bench inside a resource DAG, while A-Lab GPSS feeds runtime hardware fault logs back into an LLM recovery loop during air-sensitive solid-state synthesis. Track shared stations (central_table, cutting_board, furnace, fixture) and tools in SpatialState.active_zone_locks and active_tool_locks with write_limit_back recovery.

4. Architectural Synthesis: Unifying Assembly, Deformables, and SDLs in Project STAMP

In mincasurong/IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics, Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) combines asynchronous pre-staging from APEX-MR, compositional guards from RoboFactory, outward handle tension from SOI, and in-silico lab verification from MATTERIX, ORGANA, and A-Lab GPSS inside one ROS 2 Jazzy and Isaac Sim 6.0 stack:

  1. Typed Schema & Deterministic Gate (stamp_schemas + stamp_gate): FrankaFR3DeterministicGate verifies every TaskDAG before ROS 2 or MoveIt 2 dispatch, blocking 100.0% of injected faults (610 / 610) across IK_UNREACHABLE, WORKSPACE_COLLISION, RESOURCE_CONTENTION, and JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
  2. Closed-Loop write_limit_back Repair (stamp_feedback): stamp_feedback writes structured HardwareFaultLog certificates back into the planner prompt, raising 1,000-episode multi-arm task completion from 39.0% (single-shot) to 100.0% (gate-assisted replanning) with 0 unverified hardware dispatches.
  3. Dual-View Perception & PiP Digital Twin (isaacsim_scripts/): The simulation bridge fuses /OverheadCamera with eye-in-hand /FR3_*/fr3_hand/wrist_camera streams and renders a 320x240 Picture-in-Picture (PiP) monitor inside NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0.

5. References & Primary Literature (2022–2026)

  1. Isaac Lab: Isaac Lab: A GPU-Accelerated Simulation Framework for Multi-Modal Robot Learning, arXiv:2511.04831 · GitHub
  2. MATTERIX: MATTERIX: toward a digital twin for robotics-assisted chemistry laboratory automation, Nature Computational Science (2025/2026), DOI:10.1038/s43588-025-00924-4 · arXiv:2601.13232 · GitHub
  3. APEX-MR: APEX-MR: Multi-Robot Asynchronous Planning and Execution for Cooperative Assembly, RSS (2025), arXiv:2503.15836 · GitHub
  4. RoboFactory: RoboFactory: Exploring Embodied Agent Collaboration with Compositional Constraints, ICCV (2025), arXiv:2503.16408 · GitHub
  5. DexGarmentLab: DexGarmentLab: Dexterous Garment Manipulation Environment with Generalizable Policy, NeurIPS Spotlight (2025), arXiv:2505.11032 · GitHub
  6. GarmentLab: GarmentLab: A Unified Simulation and Benchmark for Garment Manipulation, arXiv:2411.01200 · GitHub
  7. MoDeSuite: MoDeSuite: Mobile Manipulation Deformable Object Task Suite, GitHub
  8. SOI Bimanual Bag Manipulation: Bimanual Deformable Bag Manipulation Using a Structure-of-Interest Approach, arXiv:2401.11432
  9. ORGANA: ORGANA: A robotic assistant for automated chemistry experimentation and characterization, Matter (2024/2025), Cell Press · Project Site
  10. A-Lab GPSS: Agentic LLM Reasoning in a Self-Driving Laboratory for Air-Sensitive Solid-State Synthesis (2026), arXiv:2604.11957
  11. AlabOS: AlabOS: A Python-based Reconfigurable Workflow Management Framework for Autonomous Laboratories, arXiv:2405.13930
  12. RoCo: RoCo: Dialectic Multi-Robot Collaboration with Large Language Models, ICRA (2024), arXiv:2307.04738 · GitHub
  13. Factory: Factory: Fast Contact for Robotic Assembly, RSS (2022), arXiv:2205.03532
  14. NVIDIA cuRobo & cuMotion: cuRobo Documentation · isaac_ros_cumotion
Research Provenance & Citation

This systems survey (M9G-TR-2026-04) connects 14 multi-robot assembly, deformable manipulation, and Self-Driving Laboratory frameworks from 2022–2026 with Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (장민수 · M9G).

Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G), "Multi-Robot Manipulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim (2025–2026): Cooperative Assembly, Deformable Handling, and Self-Driving Labs," M9G Technical Research Blog (M9G-TR-2026-04), Nov. 1, 2026. ko.articleTitle: NVIDIA Isaac Sim 다중 로봇 매니퓰레이션 서베이 (2025–2026): 협동 정밀 조립, 변형 물체 핸들링 및 자율 실험실(SDL)
ko.articleLede: 공유 다중 로봇 워크셀에서 LLM이 구동기에 직접 명령을 내리는 종단간 제어는 충돌과 교착으로 이어집니다. 2025–2026년 협동 조립, 변형 물체 조작, 자율 실험실(SDL) 연구는 4계층 뉴로-심볼릭 및 GPU 물리 파이프라인으로 수렴했습니다. 비전-언어 플래너는 관절 궤적 대신 타입화된 태스크 그래프(TaskDAG, MM-TPG)를 생성하고, 결정론적 사전 검증 게이트가 하드웨어 실행 전에 역기구학, 스윕 볼륨 충돌, 구역 뮤텍스를 검사합니다. 이어 GPU 제어기가 50–120 Hz 역기구학 및 양팔 장력 제어를 수행하며, 결함 로그는 플래너 프롬프트로 역주입됩니다. 본 리포트는 APEX-MR, RoboFactory, RoCo, IndustReal, cuRobo, DexGarmentLab, MoDeSuite, SOI, MATTERIX, ORGANA, A-Lab GPSS, AlabOS 등 14개 시스템을 분석하고 Project STAMP(v1.0.0-stamp)의 통합 구조를 제시합니다.
ko.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR: 4계층 뉴로-심볼릭 및 GPU 물리 아키텍처 핵심 요약
ko.finding1: 계층 1, 태스크 그래프 합성 (Plan): 비전-언어 플래너는 상단 및 손목 카메라 스트림과 3D 좌표를 파싱하여 방향성 비순환 태스크 그래프(TaskDAG) 또는 다중 모달 시간 계획 그래프(MM-TPG)를 출력하며 원시 관절 궤적은 직접 생성하지 않습니다.
ko.finding2: 계층 2, 결정론적 사전 안전 게이트 및 경합 스케줄러 (Gate): MoveIt 2 또는 실물 로봇 디스패치 전에 7자유도 역기구학 도달성, 3D AABB 스윕 볼륨 충돌, URDF 관절·토크 한계, 구역 및 도구 뮤텍스를 검증합니다.
ko.finding3: 계층 3, 50–120 Hz 스킬 및 모션 제어 (Execute): cuRobo 및 감쇠 최소제곱(DLS) 역기구학 제어기가 C2 연속 궤적과 폐루프 양팔 제약을 추종하며 유연 용기 테두리의 외향 장력을 유지합니다.
ko.finding4: 계층 4, 폐루프 컨텍스트 복구 (Write-Back): 사전 검증 거부나 런타임 슬립이 발생하면 구조화된 HardwareFaultLog 인증서를 플래너 프롬프트에 재주입(write_limit_back)하거나 무토큰 복구 서브그래프를 접합합니다.

ko.ts3Sub: 실물 실행 전 유리기구 접촉, 액체 이송, 뮤텍스 잠금 스테이션을 GPU 물리로 사전 검증.
ko.ts4Sub: 이중 시점 인지, 4계층 결정론적 안전 게이트(610/610), write_limit_back 폐루프 복구.
ko.sec1Title: 1. 다중 로봇 협동 조립: 비동기 시간 계획 그래프와 서브밀리미터 접촉 제어
ko.sec1P1: 공유 다중 로봇 작업 공간에서는 링크 간 공간 교착과 단일 강체를 두 팔로 파지할 때의 폐루프 과구속 문제가 발생합니다. 2024–2025년 시스템들은 심볼릭 작업 할당을 비동기 시간 그래프 스케줄링 및 CUDA 모션 생성과 분리하여, 활성 로봇이 정밀 삽입을 수행하는 동안 대기 로봇은 잠금 구역 밖에서 사전 배치됩니다.
ko.sec2Title: 2. 변형 물체 핸들링: 구조적 키포인트와 양팔 외향 장력 유지
ko.sec2P1: 유연한 가방, 의류, 실리콘 바구니, 와이어 하네스는 수천 개의 메쉬 정점이 동시에 변형됩니다. 원시 정점 구름을 그대로 VLM에 입력하면 파지점 그라운딩이 흔들리므로, 최신 Isaac Sim 및 Isaac Lab 프레임워크는 테두리·깃·양쪽 손잡이 같은 저차원 구조 키포인트를 추적하고 양팔 이송 중 외향 장력을 유지합니다.
ko.sec3Title: 3. 자율 실험실(SDL): 인실리코 프로토콜 사전 검증과 뮤텍스 잠금 스테이션
ko.sec3P1: 자율 화학 실험과 고상 합성에서는 시약 유출, 유리기구 파손, 글로브박스 충돌이 허용되지 않습니다. 2025–2026년 자율 실험실(SDL)은 실물 장비 구동 전에 GPU 물리 디지털 트윈에서 전체 프로토콜을 먼저 검증하고 모든 공용 장비를 뮤텍스 기반 DAG 자원으로 잠급니다.
ko.sec4Title: 4. 아키텍처 통합: 조립·변형체·자율 실험실을 하나로 묶는 Project STAMP
ko.sec4P1: mincasurong/IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics의 Project STAMP(v1.0.0-stamp)는 APEX-MR의 비동기 사전 배치, RoboFactory의 조합형 안전 가드, SOI의 외향 손잡이 장력 규칙, MATTERIX·ORGANA·A-Lab GPSS의 인실리코 실험실 검증을 단일 ROS 2 Jazzy 및 Isaac Sim 6.0 스택으로 통합합니다:
ko.syn1: 타입 스키마 및 결정론적 게이트 (stamp_schemas + stamp_gate): FrankaFR3DeterministicGate가 ROS 2 및 MoveIt 2 디스패치 전에 모든 TaskDAG를 검사하여 IK_UNREACHABLE, WORKSPACE_COLLISION, RESOURCE_CONTENTION, JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED 등 610건의 주입 결함을 100.0% 차단합니다.
ko.syn2: 폐루프 write_limit_back 복구 (stamp_feedback): stamp_feedback이 구조화된 HardwareFaultLog 인증서를 플래너 프롬프트에 역주입하여 1,000 에피소드 완수율을 단발 실행 39.0%에서 100.0%로 끌어올리며 미검증 하드웨어 디스패치를 0건으로 유지합니다.
ko.syn3: 이중 시점 인지 및 PiP 디지털 트윈 (isaacsim_scripts/): /OverheadCamera와 손목 장착 /FR3_*/fr3_hand/wrist_camera 스트림을 결합하고 Isaac Sim 6.0 내부에 320x240 PiP 모니터를 구동합니다.
ko.fig1Caption: 그림 1 (M9G-TR-2026-04). 멀티모달 TaskDAG 합성, 4계층 결정론적 사전 안전 게이트, 50 Hz ROS 2 및 Isaac Sim 6.0 제어, 폐루프 write_limit_back 복구를 결합한 Project STAMP(v1.0.0-stamp) 아키텍처.

ja.articleTag: M9G-TR-2026-04 • システムサーベイ＆アーキテクチャ統合
ja.articleTitle: NVIDIA Isaac Sim マルチロボット操作サーベイ (2025–2026)：協調組立・柔軟物操作・自律実験室 (SDL)
ja.articleLede: 共有マルチアーム作業セルにおいて、LLMからアクチュエータへ直接指令を送る構成は衝突やデッドロックを招きます。協調組立、柔軟物操作、自律実験室 (SDL) の2025–2026年システムは、4層ニューロシンボリック＋GPU物理パイプラインへ収束しました。視覚言語プランナは関節軌道ではなく型付きタスクグラフ (TaskDAG / MM-TPG) を出力し、決定論的プリフライトゲートが実行前に逆運動学、スイープ体積干渉、ゾーン排他ロックを検証します。続いてGPU制御系が50〜120 Hzの逆運動学と両腕張力制御を実行し、失敗制約はプランナ文脈へ書き戻されます。本稿はAPEX-MR、RoboFactory、RoCo、IndustReal、cuRobo、DexGarmentLab、MoDeSuite、SOI、MATTERIX、ORGANA、A-Lab GPSS、AlabOSなど14システムを整理し、Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) による統合実装を示します。
ja.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR：4層ニューロシンボリック＋GPU物理アーキテクチャの要点
ja.finding1: 第1層・タスクグラフ合成 (Plan)：視覚言語プランナは俯瞰・手首カメラと3D座標を解析し、型付き有向非巡回タスクグラフ (TaskDAG) またはマルチモーダル時間計画グラフ (MM-TPG) を生成します。生の関節軌道は直接出力しません。
ja.finding2: 第2層・決定論的プリフライト安全ゲートと競合スケジューラ (Gate)：MoveIt 2や実機ディスパッチの前に、7自由度逆運動学、3D AABBスイープ干渉、URDF関節・トルク上限、ゾーンおよびツールのミューテックスを検証します。
ja.finding3: 第3層・50〜120 Hzスキル＆モーション制御 (Execute)：cuRoboや減衰最小二乗 (DLS) IKがC2連続軌道と閉リンク両腕制約を追従し、柔軟容器リムの外向き張力を維持します。
ja.finding4: 第4層・閉ループ文脈修復 (Write-Back)：棄却された計画や実行時の位置ずれは構造化HardwareFaultLog証明書として記録され、write_limit_backでプランナ文脈へ注入されるかゼロトークン修復サブグラフで局所補修されます。
ja.kpi1Note: RSS, ICCV, NeurIPS, Nature Comput. Sci., Matter
ja.kpi3Note: 注入したマルチアーム故障 610件中 610件を遮断
ja.kpi4Note: 1,000エピソードにおける HardwareFaultLog 修復

ja.ts1Title: マルチロボット協調組立 (APEX-MR & IndustReal)
ja.ts1Sub: 非同期MM-TPG事前待機とIsaac Sim 240 Hz PhysX TGS + SDF接触組立。
ja.ts2Title: 柔軟・変形物ハンドリング (DexGarmentLab, MoDeSuite & SOI)
ja.ts2Sub: PhysX 5 PBDシミュレーションと正規ハンドルキーポイント・外向き両腕張力制御。

ja.ts3Sub: 実機実行前にガラス器具接触、液体移送、排他ロック実験装置をGPU物理で事前検証。
ja.ts4Title: Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) 統合ランタイム
ja.ts4Sub: 2視点知覚、4層決定論的安全ゲート (610/610)、write_limit_back閉ループ修復。
ja.sec1Title: 1. マルチロボット協調組立：非同期時間計画グラフとサブミリ接触制御
ja.sec1P1: 共有マルチアーム空間では、リンク間の空間デッドロックと単一剛体を両腕把持する際の閉リンク過拘束が課題となります。2024〜2025年の手法はシンボリックな作業割当を非同期グラフスケジューリングおよびCUDA軌道生成から分離し、作業中のアームが精密挿入を行う間に待機アームをロック領域外へ事前配置します。
ja.sec2Title: 2. 柔軟・変形物ハンドリング：構造キーポイントと両腕外向き張力
ja.sec2P1: 柔軟なバッグ、衣類、シリコンバスケット、ワイヤーハーネスは数千頂点が同時に変形するため、生メッシュ点群のままではVLMの把持指定が不安定になります。最新のIsaac SimおよびIsaac Lab環境は、開口部リムや襟、左右ハンドルなどの低次元構造キーポイントを追跡し、両腕搬送中に外向き張力を保ちます。
ja.sec3Title: 3. 自律実験室 (SDL)：インシリコ事前検証とミューテックス管理装置
ja.sec3P1: 自律化学実験や固相合成では、試薬こぼれやガラス器具破損、グローブボックス内衝突は許されません。2025〜2026年の自律実験室 (SDL) は実機稼働前にGPU物理ツインで全プロトコルを検証し、共有装置をミューテックス付きDAGリソースとして排他制御します。
ja.sec4Title: 4. アーキテクチャ統合：組立・柔軟物・SDLを統合する Project STAMP
ja.sec4P1: mincasurong/IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics の Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) は、APEX-MRの非同期事前待機、RoboFactoryの合成ガード、SOIの外向きハンドル張力、MATTERIX・ORGANA・A-Lab GPSSのインシリコ検証を単一のROS 2 JazzyおよびIsaac Sim 6.0基盤に統合します：
ja.syn1: 型付きスキーマと決定論的ゲート (stamp_schemas + stamp_gate)：FrankaFR3DeterministicGateがROS 2 / MoveIt 2送信前に全TaskDAGを検証し、IK_UNREACHABLE、WORKSPACE_COLLISION、RESOURCE_CONTENTION、JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDEDの注入故障610件すべて (100.0%) を遮断します。
ja.syn2: 閉ループ write_limit_back 修復 (stamp_feedback)：stamp_feedbackがHardwareFaultLog証明書をプランナ文脈へ書き戻し、1,000エピソード完遂率を単発39.0%から100.0%へ引き上げ、未検証ディスパッチ0件を維持します。
ja.syn3: 2視点知覚とPiPデジタルツイン (isaacsim_scripts/)：/OverheadCameraと手首カメラ /FR3_*/fr3_hand/wrist_camera を統合し、Isaac Sim 6.0内に320x240 PiPモニタを描画します。
ja.fig1Caption: 図1 (M9G-TR-2026-04). マルチモーダルTaskDAG合成、4層決定論的プリフライトゲート、50 Hz ROS 2 / Isaac Sim 6.0制御、閉ループwrite_limit_back修復を統合したProject STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp)。

zh.articleTag: M9G-TR-2026-04 • 系统综述与架构综合
zh.articleTitle: NVIDIA Isaac Sim 多机器人操控综述 (2025–2026)：协同装配、柔性物体处理与自动驾驶实验室 (SDL)
zh.articleLede: 在共享多机械臂工作单元中，由大模型直接驱动底层执行器极易引发碰撞与死锁。2025–2026 年的协同装配、柔性物体处理与自动驾驶实验室 (SDL) 系统已收敛至四层神经符号与 GPU 物理流水线。视觉语言规划器输出类型化任务图 (TaskDAG 或 MM-TPG)，而非原始关节轨迹；确定性预检门控在硬件执行前验证逆运动学、扫掠体积碰撞与区域互斥锁；GPU 控制器运行 50–120 Hz 逆运动学与双臂张力控制，故障日志则将受阻约束写回规划器提示词。本文综合分析 APEX-MR、RoboFactory、RoCo、IndustReal、cuRobo、DexGarmentLab、MoDeSuite、SOI、MATTERIX、ORGANA、A-Lab GPSS 与 AlabOS 等 14 套系统，并展示 Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) 如何在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 与 ROS 2 Jazzy 中实现统一运行。
zh.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR：四层神经符号与 GPU 物理架构核心要点
zh.finding1: 第 1 层，任务图合成 (Plan)：视觉语言规划器解析俯视与腕部相机流及 3D 坐标变换，输出类型化有向无环任务图 (TaskDAG) 或多模态时序规划图 (MM-TPG)，绝不直接生成关节轨迹。
zh.finding2: 第 2 层，预检安全门控与资源竞争调度 (Gate)：确定性门控在 MoveIt 2 或真机派发前检查 7 自由度逆运动学、3D AABB 扫掠体积碰撞、URDF 关节力矩上限以及多臂区域与工具互斥锁。
zh.finding3: 第 3 层，50–120 Hz 技能与运动控制 (Execute)：cuRobo 与阻尼最小二乘 (DLS) IK 跟踪 C2 连续轨迹，维持闭链主从双臂约束，并对柔性容器边缘保持外向张力。
zh.finding4: 第 4 层，闭环上下文修复 (Write-Back)：被拦截的计划或运行时位姿滑移会生成结构化 HardwareFaultLog 证书，反馈模块将其写回规划器上下文 (write_limit_back) 或拼接零 Token 恢复子图。

zh.kpi4Note: 1,000 回合 HardwareFaultLog 修复验证

zh.ts1Title: 多机器人协同装配 (APEX-MR & IndustReal)
zh.ts1Sub: 异步 MM-TPG 预备位调度与 Isaac Sim 240 Hz PhysX TGS + SDF 精密接触装配。
zh.ts2Title: 柔性及可变形物体操控 (DexGarmentLab, MoDeSuite & SOI)
zh.ts2Sub: 基于 PhysX 5 PBD 仿真、规范提手关键点与双臂外向张力保持。
zh.ts3Title: 自动驾驶实验室数字孪生 (MATTERIX, ORGANA & A-Lab GPSS)
zh.ts3Sub: 在真机运行前通过 GPU 物理孪生验证玻璃器皿、液体转移与互斥锁工位。
zh.ts4Sub: 双视角感知、四层确定性安全门控 (610/610) 与 write_limit_back 闭环修复。
zh.sec1Title: 1. 多机器人协同装配：异步时序规划图与亚毫米级接触控制
zh.sec1P1: 共享多臂工作空间面临两大物理瓶颈：连杆碰撞导致的空间死锁，以及双臂共持刚性零件时的闭链过约束。2024–2025 年的代表系统将符号任务分配与异步图调度、CUDA 运动生成解耦，让等待机械臂在锁定区域外预备就位，同时由工作机械臂完成亚毫米级接触装配。
zh.sec2Title: 2. 柔性物体处理：结构关键点与双臂外向张力保持
zh.sec2P1: 柔性袋、衣物、硅胶篮与线束在操控中会发生数千个网格顶点的形变，直接输入原始顶点点云会导致视觉语言抓取定位失稳。近期 Isaac Sim 与 Isaac Lab 框架转而追踪袋口边缘、衣领和双提手等低维结构关键点，并在双臂搬运期间保持外向张力。
zh.sec3Title: 3. 自动驾驶实验室 (SDL)：硅上协议预验证与互斥锁工位
zh.sec3P1: 自动化湿法化学与固态合成绝不允许试剂洒漏、玻璃器皿破损或手套箱碰撞。2025–2026 年的自动驾驶实验室 (SDL) 先在 GPU 物理孪生中预演完整实验协议，并将每台共享仪器锁定为互斥 DAG 资源后再下发硬件执行。
zh.sec4Title: 4. 架构综合：Project STAMP 统一装配、柔性操控与自动驾驶实验室
zh.sec4P1: 在 mincasurong/IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics 中，Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) 将 APEX-MR 的异步预就位、RoboFactory 的组合安全守卫、SOI 的双提手外向张力规则以及 MATTERIX、ORGANA、A-Lab GPSS 的硅上实验室预检统一到同一套 ROS 2 Jazzy 与 Isaac Sim 6.0 运行时中：
zh.syn1: 类型化模式与确定性门控 (stamp_schemas + stamp_gate)：FrankaFR3DeterministicGate 在 ROS 2 / MoveIt 2 派发前校验每一张 TaskDAG，在 IK_UNREACHABLE、WORKSPACE_COLLISION、RESOURCE_CONTENTION 与 JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED 四类故障上实现 100.0% 拦截 (610 / 610)。
zh.syn2: 闭环 write_limit_back 修复 (stamp_feedback)：stamp_feedback 将结构化 HardwareFaultLog 证书写回规划器提示词，使 1,000 回合多臂任务完成率从单次生成的 39.0% 提升至 100.0%，且未验证硬件派发为 0。
zh.syn3: 双视角感知与画中画数字孪生 (isaacsim_scripts/)：仿真桥接融合 /OverheadCamera 与腕部相机 /FR3_*/fr3_hand/wrist_camera 数据流，并在 Isaac Sim 6.0 视口内渲染 320x240 画中画监控器。
zh.fig1Caption: 图 1 (M9G-TR-2026-04)。Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) 融合多模态 TaskDAG 合成、四层确定性预检门控、50 Hz ROS 2 与 Isaac Sim 6.0 控制以及闭环 write_limit_back 上下文修复。
zh.provBody: 本系统综述 (M9G-TR-2026-04) 将 2022–2026 年间 14 项多机器人装配、柔性物体操控与自动驾驶实验室框架同张民洙博士 (Minsu Chang, Ph.D. · M9G) 构建的 Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) 进行了架构贯通。

es.articleTag: M9G-TR-2026-04 • Estudio de Sistemas y Síntesis Arquitectónica
es.articleTitle: Manipulación Multirrobot en NVIDIA Isaac Sim (2025–2026): Ensamblaje Cooperativo, Objetos Deformables y Laboratorios Autónomos
es.articleLede: El envío directo desde un LLM hacia los actuadores falla en celdas multirrobot compartidas. En ensamblaje cooperativo, manipulación de objetos deformables y Laboratorios Autónomos (SDLs), los sistemas robóticos de 2025–2026 convergen en una arquitectura neuro-simbólica y de física en GPU de cuatro niveles. Los planificadores visión-lenguaje emiten grafos de tareas tipados (TaskDAG o MM-TPG) en lugar de trayectorias articulares. Las compuertas deterministas previas al despacho verifican la cinemática, los volúmenes barridos y los mutex de zona antes de mover el hardware. Los controladores en GPU ejecutan cinemática inversa de 50 a 120 Hz y tensión bimanual, mientras los registros de fallos reinyectan restricciones en el contexto del planificador. Este informe sintetiza 14 sistemas, entre ellos APEX-MR, RoboFactory, RoCo, IndustReal, cuRobo, DexGarmentLab, MoDeSuite, SOI, MATTERIX, ORGANA, A-Lab GPSS y AlabOS, y muestra cómo Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) los unifica en NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 y ROS 2 Jazzy.
es.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR: Arquitectura Neuro-Simbólica y Física en GPU de Cuatro Niveles
es.finding1: Nivel 1, Síntesis de Grafos de Tareas (Plan): Los planificadores visión-lenguaje convierten vídeo cenital y de muñeca junto con transformaciones 3D en Grafos Acíclicos Dirigidos de Tareas (TaskDAGs) o Grafos Temporales Multimodales (MM-TPGs), sin emitir trayectorias articulares crudas.
es.finding2: Nivel 2, Compuerta Determinista Pre-Despacho y Planificador de Contención (Gate): Una compuerta determinista comprueba cinemática inversa de 7 GdL, colisiones barridas AABB 3D, límites articulares y de par URDF, y bloqueos mutex de zonas y herramientas antes de MoveIt 2 o el hardware.
es.finding3: Nivel 3, Control de Habilidades y Movimiento a 50–120 Hz (Execute): Los generadores en GPU (cuRobo e IK por mínimos cuadrados amortiguados) siguen trayectorias C2, imponen restricciones bimanuales de cadena cerrada y mantienen tensión exterior en contenedores flexibles.
es.finding4: Nivel 4, Reparación de Contexto en Lazo Cerrado (Write-Back): Los planes rechazados o deslizamientos en ejecución generan certificados HardwareFaultLog estructurados que regresan al prompt del planificador (write_limit_back) o empalman subgrafos locales sin coste de tokens.

es.sec1Title: 1. Ensamblaje Cooperativo Multirrobot: Grafos Temporales Asíncronos y Contacto Submilimétrico
es.sec1P1: Los espacios multirrobot compartidos sufren dos cuellos de botella físicos: bloqueos espaciales entre eslabones y sobrerrestricción cinemática de cadena cerrada cuando dos brazos sujetan una misma pieza rígida. Los sistemas de 2024 y 2025 separan la asignación simbólica de la planificación temporal asíncrona y la generación de movimiento en CUDA. Los brazos en espera se pre-posicionan fuera de las zonas bloqueadas mientras los brazos activos realizan inserciones submilimétricas.
es.sec2Title: 2. Manipulación de Objetos Deformables: Puntos Clave Estructurales y Tensión Bimanual
es.sec2P1: Las bolsas flexibles, prendas, cestas de silicona y mazos de cables se deforman en miles de vértices de malla. Pasar nubes de vértices crudas a un modelo visión-lenguaje desestabiliza el agarre. Los entornos recientes en Isaac Sim e Isaac Lab rastrean puntos clave estructurales de baja dimensión como bordes, cuellos y asas dobles, manteniendo tensión hacia afuera durante el transporte bimanual.
es.sec3Title: 3. Laboratorios Autónomos (SDLs): Verificación In-Silico de Protocolos y Estaciones con Mutex
es.sec3P1: La química húmeda autónoma y la síntesis en estado sólido no toleran derrames de reactivos, rotura de cristalería ni colisiones en cajas de guantes. Los Laboratorios Autónomos (SDLs) de 2025–2026 validan primero los protocolos en gemelos físicos en GPU y bloquean cada estación compartida como un recurso DAG con mutex antes del despacho al hardware.
es.sec4Title: 4. Síntesis Arquitectónica: Unificación de Ensamblaje, Deformables y SDLs en Project STAMP
es.sec4P1: En mincasurong/IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics, Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) combina el pre-posicionamiento asíncrono de APEX-MR, las guardas composicionales de RoboFactory, la tensión exterior de asas de SOI y la verificación in-silico de MATTERIX, ORGANA y A-Lab GPSS en una sola pila sobre ROS 2 Jazzy e Isaac Sim 6.0:
es.syn1: Esquema Tipado y Compuerta Determinista (stamp_schemas + stamp_gate): FrankaFR3DeterministicGate verifica cada TaskDAG antes del despacho a ROS 2 o MoveIt 2, bloqueando el 100.0% de los fallos inyectados (610 / 610) en IK_UNREACHABLE, WORKSPACE_COLLISION, RESOURCE_CONTENTION y JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
es.syn2: Reparación write_limit_back en Lazo Cerrado (stamp_feedback): stamp_feedback reinyecta certificados HardwareFaultLog estructurados en el prompt del planificador, elevando la finalización en 1,000 episodios del 39.0% en un solo intento al 100.0% con 0 despachos sin verificar.
es.syn3: Percepción Dual y Gemelo Digital PiP (isaacsim_scripts/): El puente de simulación fusiona /OverheadCamera con las cámaras en muñeca /FR3_*/fr3_hand/wrist_camera y muestra un monitor Picture-in-Picture (PiP) de 320x240 dentro de NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0.
